key_catalyst: Brent crude above $100 on widening Houthi/Iran conflict, driving 10-year yields to 4.70% and compressing mega-cap tech multiples
reasoning: Three independent bearish catalysts compounded today: Brent broke $100 on Houthi attacks (up from ~$90 on 07-20 and ~$96 on 07-23, a clear escalation ladder), Alphabet and Tesla both posted negative free cash flow with capex guidance raised, and brand-new Section 301 tariffs on 60 countries covering ~99% of imports took effect this morning. The market did not shrug this off — QQQ fell 1.37% today on top of 1.90% on 07-23, and the tariff regime is a novel catalyst with no prior occurrence in the recent history, while the oil/yield spiral (10-year at 4.70%) remains actively escalating rather than resolving.
